description: WITH OWNERACCESS OPTION as default Admin on an unsecured file. A SELECT with the clause through direct OpenRecordset, a saved QueryDef QOwn (its SQL round trip, Type and Properties) and a temporary QueryDef; a saved INSERT with the clause run by QueryDef.Execute; a direct SELECT ... INTO with the clause and the same INSERT without it, both with dbFailOnError; then the wrong-method controls QOwn.Execute and OpenRecordset on the saved INSERT. Asks each return, Errors, RecordsAffected and the rows read.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-2-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
